findings.title: CMD targets a nonexistent entrypoint
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3: “The CMD points at a path that exists in the built image.”
findings.trigger: The container starts using its default CMD.
findings.consequence: Python cannot open `/app/server/main.py`, so the container exits and no HTTP server listens on port 8080.
findings.evidence: Dockerfile uses `COPY src/ .`, placing the README-described `src/main.py` at `/app/main.py`, but CMD is `['python', '/app/server/main.py']`. README.md explicitly states there is no `server/` directory.

reasoning: The described repository layout supports the COPY and dependency-install steps, but the default command references a path that cannot exist in the resulting image. This directly defeats criterion 3 and consequently prevents criterion 2. No out-of-scope hardening concerns were raised.
